name: WF-086 Communication Runtime Readiness & Safety Gate

parameters.jsCode: const requestedChannel=String(($json.body??$json).channel||'').toLowerCase(); const channels=requestedChannel?[requestedChannel]:['email','sms']; const base=String($env.AGENTICMAIL_API_URL||'').trim(); const key=String($env.AGENTICMAIL_API_KEY||'').trim(); const emailPath=String($env.AGENTICMAIL_EMAIL_SEND_PATH||'/api/agenticmail/mail/send').trim(); const smsPath=String($env.AGENTICMAIL_SMS_SEND_PATH||'').trim(); const checks={runtime_api_url_configured:!!base,runtime_api_key_configured:!!key,email_send_path_configured:!!emailPath,sms_send_path_configured:!!smsPath}; const channelReady={email:checks.runtime_api_url_configured&&checks.runtime_api_key_configured&&checks.email_send_path_configured,sms:checks.runtime_api_url_configured&&checks.runtime_api_key_configured&&checks.sms_send_path_configured}; const unsupported=channels.filter(c=>!['email','sms'].includes(c)); const ready=unsupported.length===0&&channels.every(c=>channelReady[c]); return[{json:{adapter:'wf-086',status:ready?'ready':'blocked',requested_channels:channels,channel_ready:channelReady,checks,unsupported_channels:unsupported,configuration:{email_send_path:emailPath,sms_send_path_configured:!!smsPath,api_url_present:!!base,api_key_present:!!key},safety:{secrets_excluded_from_response:true,dnc_hard_suppression_required:true,autonomous_opt_in_required:true,provider_receipt_required:true},next_action:ready?'Run controlled test traffic before enabling production autonomous sends.':'Configure the missing runtime values before enabling autonomous communication.'}}];
